div.div: The source-document trace. For the sources shown, SourceDocumentType names the table a posting came from, and SourceDocumentID holds the key of the row in that table (payroll summary postings carry a code instead). Because one column can point to several tables, no single foreign key can describe the link. It is a logical link that analysts test. A few ledger rows typed PayrollPayment point to payments that do not exist.
